t: What Ibn Masʿud told his wife to say instead
a: اشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي لاَ شِفَاءَ إِلاَّ شِفَاؤُكَ شِفَاءً لاَ يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
p: Ishfi anta-sh-shāfī, lā shifāʾa illā shifāʾuk, shifāʾan lā yughādiru saqamā
m: Heal, You are the Healer. There is no healing but Your healing. A healing that leaves no illness behind.
